content: Real, structural gap found by an actual upload attempt: our plugins only ever had plugin.json at the plugin root, never under .claude-plugin/, which claude plugin validate tolerated but Cowork's own upload path requires explicitly. Also surfaced the author-field warning, same pattern as the earlier missing agent-description warning -- claude plugin validate keeps finding small real gaps our hand-authoring missed, cycle after cycle. Separately: the original zip failed for an unrelated reason too -- it was the whole repo (a marketplace of 2 plugins), not a single plugin, so per-plugin zips are the correct artifact for the 'Upload a plugin' flow regardless of the manifest fix.
